name: Bacchudrake
look: a festive serpentine rose-gold dragon draped in purple grape bunches and golden ivy, trailing ribbons of sparkling rosé
entry: Said to appear only once a century during the grandest autumn harvest, Bacchudrake's joyous roar turns ordinary river water into sparkling nectar.
how: Wild: ultra-rare in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0), level 60-70.
It learns Effervescent Roar at level 40.
